en.askTitle: Put in your own brief and audience to get the same logged-out slide-tool test and an honest draft deck
en.runTitle: A coffee-subscription owner needs a 6-slide investor deck without opening a single new account

fields.label: Your confirmed brief
fields.value: Brewline delivers freshly roasted specialty coffee beans to small offices (5–50 staff) every two weeks; plans start at $89/month; assume 40 paying offices after 6 months; six slides: problem, solution, how it works, pricing, traction, ask

fields.label: Audience and purpose
fields.value: Investors; a quick 6-slide investor-style pitch deck

en.template: Make an investor-style deck from {brief} for {audience}. Keep supplied prices, label assumptions and leave missing revenue, plans, funding amounts and targets as placeholders. If trying a tool, separate creation access, sign-in, output, export and watermarks; quality is untested if no deck exists. Do not create accounts, pay, import sign-ins or publish.

phases.title: Try each slide maker logged out with the same coffee-subscription brief, saving screenshots
phases.note: Free routes only: no sign-ups, no payments
phases.judgment: It caught its own mistake: the first Google visit reused a browser that was already signed in and created a blank deck. It threw that result out, retested in a clean browser, and told you about it. No prompt was ever sent from the signed-in browser.

phases.title: Build the six-slide baseline deck by hand and check every page visually
phases.note: An editable deck to judge the tools against, plus the remaining tools
phases.judgment: In its own baseline deck it did not invent what you hadn’t said: 40 paying offices is labelled an assumption, $3,560 a month is marked as an illustration only, and the funding ask is left blank.

phases.title: Score the tools, build the comparison page and workbook, then verify and deliver
phases.note: Scores, screenshots and raw results in one page and one spreadsheet
phases.judgment: An independent reviewer opened the exported file itself and confirmed FreeSlide’s invented prices, ~$4.5k monthly revenue and $500k raise were really on the slides. It also pushed back that “same brief on ten products” overstated things, since several stopped before any prompt could be typed.

workers: Tried Google Slides, PowerPoint on the web and SlidesAI while logged out, and saved screenshots of where each one stopped
Built the six-slide baseline deck by hand as an editable PowerPoint file, to compare the tools against
Tried Gamma, Canva and Beautiful.ai the same way, then SlideMaker, each in its own clean browser tab
Independently checked the finished comparison page, workbook and decks against the saved evidence

zh.askTitle: 填入你自己的简报和听众，就能得到同样的免登录幻灯片工具实测，和一份如实标注的草稿
zh.runTitle: 咖啡订阅小老板想要 6 页融资演示稿，而且不想多开任何账号

fields.label: 你已确认的简报
fields.value: Brewline 每两周给 5–50 人的小办公室配送新鲜烘焙的精品咖啡豆；套餐 $89/月起；假设 6 个月后有 40 家付费办公室；共六页：问题、方案、流程、定价、进展、融资诉求

fields.label: 听众和用途
fields.value: 投资人；快速做一份 6 页的融资风格演示稿

zh.template: 请根据{brief}，为{audience}制作融资风格演示。保留已提供的价格，标明假设，缺失的收入、套餐、融资额和目标请留占位。如需尝试工具，分开记录创建入口、登录要求、输出、导出和水印；没有生成演示，就将质量标为未测试。不要创建账号、付款、导入登录状态或发布。

phases.title: 未登录状态下，用同一份咖啡订阅简报逐个试用幻灯片工具并截图
phases.note: 只试免费入口：不注册、不付款
phases.judgment: 它发现了自己的失误：第一次打开 Google 时沿用了已有的登录状态，建出一份空白演示稿。它把这个结果剔除，在干净环境里重测，并向你如实说明。已登录的那次从未发送任何提示词。

phases.title: 亲手做 6 页基准演示稿，并逐页目视检查
phases.note: 一份可编辑的基准稿，用来衡量各工具，并继续试其余工具
phases.judgment: 在自己做的基准稿里，它没有编造你没说过的内容：40 家付费办公室标明是假设，每月 $3,560 只作示例，融资金额留空。

phases.title: 给工具打分，做对比页和工作簿，再核对并交付
phases.note: 评分、截图和原始结果，放进一个页面和一张表格
phases.judgment: 独立复核同事打开了导出的文件本身，确认 FreeSlide 编造的价格、约 $4.5k 月收入和 $500k 融资，确实写在幻灯片里。它还指出“同一份简报试了十个产品”的说法过头了，因为有几个在能输入提示词之前就被挡住了。

workers: 在未登录状态下试了 Google Slides、PowerPoint 网页版和 SlidesAI，并截图记下每个工具在哪一步被挡住
亲手做了一份 6 页的可编辑 PowerPoint 基准稿，用来和各工具对照
用同样的办法试了 Gamma、Canva 和 Beautiful.ai，之后又试了 SlideMaker，每个都在独立干净的浏览器标签里
独立核对做好的对比页、工作簿和演示稿，对照保存下来的证据
